patches.proposed_summary: A day-trip journey page for Bà Nà Hills: pickup, tickets, cable car, photos, food or drinks, and the return ride.
patches.proposed_section_copy: at-glance | Treat Bà Nà Hills as a day-trip flow, not just a place name. The useful moments are pickup, tickets, cable car, photos, food or drinks, and the return ride. ⏎ --- ⏎ quick-say | Use this at the ticket counter or when asking staff for help. ⏎ --- ⏎ journey-flow | Follow the day trip in order: pickup, tickets, cable car, photos, food or drinks, and return ride. ⏎ --- ⏎ key-phrases | Use these phrases when the trip moves from planning into action. ⏎ --- ⏎ breakdown | Learn the name as recognition. Do not translate the proper name word by word. ⏎ --- ⏎ good-to-know | Ticket rules, hours, and pickup details can change. Keep your ticket or booking screen visible, and confirm where your return ride will meet you. ⏎ --- ⏎ explore-next | Practice the next phrases for getting there, finding the cable car, asking for photos, buying food or drinks, and getting back.
patches.proposed_breakdown_labels: Bà Nà -> name recognition | Hills -> English word in the attraction name | Bà Nà Hills -> Ba Na Hills
patches.proposed_visible_phrase_rows: pickup: Đi Bà Nà Hills -> Go to Ba Na Hills | ticket: Dạ, cho tôi hai vé lên Bà Nà Hills. -> Two tickets to Ba Na Hills, please. | cable-car: Cáp treo ở đâu? -> Where is the cable car? | photo: Bạn chụp giúp tôi được không? -> Can you take a photo for me? | food-drinks: Cho tôi chai nước -> A bottle of water please | return: Gọi giúp tôi taxi được không? -> Can you call me a taxi?
